Healthcare Dataset Exploration

Reproducible exploratory data analysis in R

October 29, 2026

Purpose and scope

This report explores the supplied hospital admissions dataset. It describes distributions and group differences; it does not establish causes or support clinical decisions. The dataset is commonly circulated for educational use and may be synthetic. Findings apply only to the file analyzed.

Data quality and overview

The input contains 1000 rows and 16 columns before cleaning. The analysis excludes patient and clinician names, standardizes column names and whitespace, parses dates and billing values, and removes rows with ages outside 0–120. Missing values are retained so their extent remains visible.

Date parsing expects month/day/year values. Unparseable dates become missing; length of stay is calculated as discharge date minus admission date. Check the source before interpreting any unexpected missing dates or negative stays.

Limitations

  • Dataset provenance, collection methods, and representativeness depend on the exact CSV supplied.
  • Rows are treated as admissions; a patient may appear more than once, and patient identifiers are deliberately removed from the analysis output.
  • Unmeasured variables and data quality issues can affect billing, length of stay, and group comparisons.
  • Group differences are descriptive. They do not show that a condition, insurer, hospital, medication, or admission type caused an outcome.
  • Do not use this analysis to make decisions about real patients or providers.

Reproduce

Place the authorized source CSV in data/healthcare_dataset.csv and run Rscript scripts/run_analysis.R. The runner writes the cleaned data, summary tables, charts, and this report under outputs/.
